Players Committee card image of [[DS-61-5 (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 when piloting Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/ds615_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 83cacba] (19 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
